fields.imerg_rain_mm: IMERG rain in the 10-day step (mm); null if a day is missing
fields.imerg_wy_to_date_mm: IMERG rain since 1 Oct (water year to date, mm) at imerg_obs_date
fields.imerg_wy_to_date_normal_mm: mean IMERG water-year-to-date for the same day, water years 2001-2025
fields.smap_rootzone_pct: SMAP L4 root-zone (0-100 cm) soil moisture percentile, ours: rank of the day's value among all SMAP days 2015-2025 within +-15 days of the same date (0 = driest on record for the season), step mean
fields.smap_rootzone_pctl_product: SMAP L4 product percentile (sm_rootzone_pctl, vs the model's long climatology); missing on a third to a half of days at these cells
fields.smap_rootzone_m3m3: SMAP L4 root-zone soil moisture, m3/m3
fields.smap_surface_m3m3: SMAP L4 surface (0-5 cm) soil moisture, m3/m3
fields.smap_l3_sm_m3m3: SMAP L3 retrieved surface soil moisture, recommended-quality retrievals only (flooded rice often fails)
fields.grace_gw_pct: GRACE-DA groundwater percentile (weekly; latest week starting within 6 days before the step end)
fields.modis_ndvi_anomaly: MODIS NDVI minus 2000-2025 mean of the same 16-day period
fields.ecostress_esi: ECOSTRESS Evaporative Stress Index (actual/potential ET, 0-1; low = stressed), clear scenes
fields.ecostress_et_mm_day: ECOSTRESS JPL daily ET (mm/day), clear scenes
fields.dswx_water_frac: OPERA DSWx share of the field under water (max over clear scenes in the step)
fields.hls_ndvi: HLS field-median NDVI (latest clear scene in the step)

imerg.title: NASA GPM IMERG daily precipitation V07 (Final run; Late run after the last Final day), 0.1 deg

smap_l4.title: NASA SMAP L4 Global 3-hourly 9 km Surface and Root Zone Soil Moisture (SPL4SMGP v008), via AppEEARS

grace.title: NASA GRACE/GRACE-FO data-assimilation drought indicators (GRACEDADM_CLSM025GL_7D v3.0), 0.25 deg weekly

dswx.title: NASA/JPL OPERA Dynamic Surface Water Extent from HLS (OPERA_L3_DSWX-HLS_V1), 30 m
